title: oscformat
description: OSC messages to and from Pd lists

messages.description: list to format into an OSC packet

arguments.description: list of one or more addresses

flags.name: -f <symbol>
flags.description: sets format as in the 'format' message

body:
[oscformat] makes OSC (Open Sound Control) packets, byte by byte, suitable for sending over the network with [netsend] in UDP binary mode. The OSC address (the strings between the slashes) is given by the creation arguments or by "set" messages.

If a format is given (with the -f flag or the 'format' message), it interprets incoming data as integer, float, string or 'blob'. Blobs are given as an atom count followed by that number of elements; if the count is negative, the entire remaining message is included. Elements left over at the end of the format string get the default float and symbol conversions.
